notes.subject: kunbolo
notes.rationale: גב 'back/rim' bɛ sɔn Bamanankan 'kunbolo' (kundesɛn) ye — 'rounded' kɔrɔ ka jɔ kun bolo la

notes.subject: ŋgɔmisinen
notes.rationale: אופן (ofan) bɛ bayɛlɛma 'ŋgɔmisinen' ye — Bamanankan tɛ Heburu daɲɛ kɔrɔ sɔrɔ sira dɔgɔnen na

notes.subject: אופנים/אופניהם
notes.rationale: ofan daɲɛ in bɛ kuma kelen in kɔnɔ fila: ofanw ni ofanw — Yehezkel ka fɔcogo, a bɛ to Bamanankan na ni 'ŋgɔmisinenw' sansilan ye

notes.subject: ofan naani
notes.rationale: jatebagan naani (four wheels) bɛ tɔgɔli kumasen in kɔnɔ

translation: U sogo bɛɛ, u kunbolo, u bolow, u jɛgɛmaw, ani ŋgɔmisinenw — ɲɛw bɛ u la ka bɔ u fan bɛɛ la; ofan naani minnu bɛ u ye, o ŋgɔmisinenw de.

tokens.gloss: ka bɔ u fan bɛɛ la
ofan naani minnu bɛ u ye
